cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) AS highest_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry), window AS (SELECT ts, wind FROM telemetry, latest WHERE ts >= latest.m - INTERVAL '2 days') SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM window GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.reason: right values, column roles out of order (day, vessel, max_wave)
cases.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT vessel, ts::date AS day, wave_height,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vessel, ts::date ORDER BY wave_height DESC) AS rn
    FROM telemetry
)
SELECT vessel, day, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY vessel, day
ORDER BY vessel, day

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry),
last_day AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= (SELECT m - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM latest))
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM last_day
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora'
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
WITH bucketed AS (
  SELECT vessel,
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS bucket,
    wind
  FROM telemetry
)
SELECT bucket,
  vessel,
  AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket, vessel
ORDER BY bucket, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS mx FROM telemetry),
     base AS (SELECT ts, vessel, speed FROM telemetry, latest WHERE ts >= mx - INTERVAL '7 days')
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM base
GROUP BY hour_of_day
ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT extract(dow from ts) AS day_of_week, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY day_of_week

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS ts, AVG(speed) AS speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora'), window AS (SELECT ts, water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= (SELECT m FROM latest) - INTERVAL '7 days') SELECT ts, water_temp FROM window ORDER BY ts

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS max_ts FROM telemetry), last24 AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= (SELECT max_ts - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM latest)), avg_speed AS (SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_spd FROM last24 GROUP BY vessel) SELECT vessel, avg_spd FROM avg_speed ORDER BY avg_spd DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= (SELECT m - INTERVAL '12 hours' FROM latest)
)
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour,
       vessel,
       AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave
FROM windowed
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry), window AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AS start, m AS end FROM latest) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS mean_speed FROM telemetry, window WHERE ts >= window.start AND ts <= window.end GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry), window AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' AS end_ts FROM latest) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry, window WHERE ts >= end_ts - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND ts < end_ts GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS mx FROM telemetry), base AS (SELECT ts, vessel, speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= (SELECT mx - INTERVAL '7 days' FROM latest) AND vessel IN ('Kestrel','Nomad')) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM base GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS mx FROM telemetry), window AS (SELECT ts, vessel, speed, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= (SELECT mx - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM latest) AND vessel != 'Aurora') SELECT hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM window GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(ts) AS mx FROM telemetry
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT ts, vessel, speed
  FROM telemetry, latest
  WHERE ts >= mx - INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND lat > 50
)
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
       vessel,
       AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM filtered
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql:

FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hours_above_30
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', ts) AS hour
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30
  GROUP BY hour
)

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY avg_wave DESC
LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(ts) AS mx FROM telemetry
),
recent AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= (SELECT mx - INTERVAL '7 days' FROM latest)
),
avg_speed AS (
  SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_spd
  FROM recent
  GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, avg_spd
FROM avg_speed
ORDER BY avg_spd DESC
LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY avg_wind DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql:
WITH min_temp AS (
    SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS coldest
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel
FROM min_temp
ORDER BY coldest ASC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
WITH vessel_stats AS (
    SELECT vessel,
           CORR(wind, speed) AS corr
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, corr
FROM vessel_stats
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql:
WITH vessel_extremes AS (
    SELECT vessel,
           MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp,
           MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp
    FROM telemetry
    GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, max_temp - min_temp AS temp_range
FROM vessel_extremes
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry),
     window AS (SELECT m - INTERVAL '7 days' AS start, m AS end FROM latest)
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
       vessel,
       AVG(speed) AS avg_speed,
       AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave
FROM telemetry, window
WHERE ts >= window.start AND ts < window.end
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS m FROM telemetry), windowed AS (SELECT ts, wave_height, wind, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= (SELECT m - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM latest) AND wind > 0) SELECT hour, AVG(wave_height / wind) AS avg_ratio FROM windowed GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql:

FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day'

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
WITH first_week AS (
    SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
    FROM telemetry
    WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY vessel
),
second_week AS (
    SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
    FROM telemetry
    WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-07 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT f.vessel, f.avg_speed AS first_week_avg, s.avg_speed AS second_week_avg
FROM first_week f
JOIN second_week s USING (vessel)
ORDER BY f.vessel
